title: GitLab Runner authentication token: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: underscore after the prefix (glrt_ vs the documented glrt-) and internal marker: checksum; the last 7 base36 characters are not the CRC32 of the preceding text (every other byte, width and alphabet unchanged), which GitLab's routable_token.rb never emits and its offline check rejects. Twin of "GitLab Runner authentication token: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of gitlab-runner-authentication-token-config-toml: internal marker: checksum; the last 7 base36 characters are not the CRC32 of the preceding text (every other byte, width and alphabet unchanged), which GitLab's routable_token.rb never emits and its offline check rejects. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
